meta.purpose: R5: the Widom-along-the-chain estimator has no kUPS counterpart to validate against (no shipped kUPS example runs N-guest NVT and Widom together). This validates widom_chain_kernel!'s test particle correctly seeing every OTHER existing guest (not only the host) against an independent, non-incremental oracle: a literal Ewald sum (ewald_energy) over every host-plus-guest position, computed once before and once after appending the test guest, never using the incremental Sk machinery under test.
meta.why_boltzmann_weight_not_raw_deltaU: insertion_constant_term/FrameworkBatch.constant_offset folds in an ORIENTATION-AVERAGED reciprocal self term (self_mean), not the exact per-orientation value, so any single insertion's raw ΔU carries a real, orientation-dependent error (bounded by self_term_halfrange). self_mean is defined as exactly the average of the true per-orientation value, so this error has zero mean and washes out in an average over enough random poses -- the same quantity Widom's own mu_ex estimator accumulates. A single-pose exact comparison was tried first and correctly failed at the ~1e-4 relative level for this reason before this statistical form was adopted.
